name: 阿尔凯
src: 月银纪史诗/第四歌_雷纹豹裘.md:203
who: Arke, a human giant of thirty-seven, a herder's son of the black-stone highland who serves a king: about 206 cm, a walking mountain, shoulders wide enough for two children to sit side by side, forearms with sinews like twisted cables, a deep chest. Black curly hair with a blue gloss, a short curly beard, deeply tanned bronze skin from a lifetime on the hills. Eyes of real gold, a ring of gold round the pupil, that burn like molten metal when he is angry. A strong, regular face like a temple statue, a high nose and a broad jaw, but the brow is always knitted and there are two dark shadows under the eyes. Scars layered on scars, the deepest across his chest (a leopard's claw). Grim, tired, heavy-hearted, gentle underneath.
face: FACE, as in the references: a strong grown man's face of thirty-seven, NOT boyish: gold eyes with a ring of gold round the pupil, thick black brows knitted, two dark shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, a broad jaw with a short curly black beard, a grim closed mouth; skin shadows a warm bronze.
build: 206 cm, enormous: very wide shoulders and back, thick cable-like forearms, a deep chest, heavy legs.
palette: thunder gold and electric blue, leopard dun, olive-wood brown, black
casual: His everyday dress: the whole pelt of a thunder-striped leopard king draped over his shoulders, the leopard's head set on his head like a helm, the two front paws knotted across his chest, tiny blue sparks crawling in the fur at the tips; under it only a coarse hemp short tunic belted with a plain leather belt, and shoes of hide laced with cords to the calves. In his right hand a whole olive tree torn from the mountain as a club, its root end heavy. A grim, heavy look.
private: Resting: no pelt, the head-helm off; a loose, long-sleeved undyed hemp tunic and rolled brown trousers, hide shoes. The great olive club leans on his shoulder; a tired, quiet look.
battle: Ready to strike: the leopard pelt tied tight over the shoulders with the head on his head and the paws knotted at the chest, the hemp tunic belted tight, leather bracers over the forearms. He grips the olive-wood club raised in his right hand, and a great bow strung with the sinew of a nine-headed vine-serpent king is slung across his back; blue sparks run along the fur. A fierce, angry look, the gold eyes burning.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced and furious, the shoulders squared, the feet planted wide, the olive-wood club gripped in the right hand raised beside the head and the left hand open at the side; a fierce look, the gold eyes burning, the mouth closed.
formal: Standing before the king: the leopard pelt brushed clean and worn over the shoulders without the helm, the head resting on his shoulder, over a clean long hemp tunic with a woven belt clasped in bronze; the great bow slung on his back, no club. He stands very upright and still with the hands at his sides; a grave, dutiful look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the real-gold eyes looking at the viewer with a weary, heavy, unflinching look, the mouth closed. Pale blue lightning-like light from one side, warm dun firelight from the other. Foreground blur: crawling blue sparks and drifting dust. He wears the leopard head as a helm with the paws knotted at his chest.

name: 伊奥
src: 月银纪史诗/第四歌_雷纹豹裘.md:259
who: Io, a human man of twenty-two, a cart driver and torch bearer and the nephew of the king's giant, a lean, lively young man: about 174 cm, wiry and light on his feet, shoulders and back toughened by eight years of pulling reins. Short curly hair of bright orange-red with one lock always sticking up over the forehead, olive-green eyes, small dimples in both cheeks when he laughs, a light scatter of freckles over the nose. A big old burn scar over the back of his right hand and forearm, white, shiny and wrinkled, which he never covers (on the viewer's left when they face us). Three loops of hemp rope round his waist. On his back a staff bound with iron hoops, topped with a torch whose flame never goes out. No leopard pelt yet. A warm, jokey, easy air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a young man's open, friendly face, NOT angular: bright olive-green, softly slanted eyes with a thin tapering dark-brown upper lash line; light orange-red eyebrows; a scatter of faint freckles; small dimples in both cheeks when he smiles; a small straight nose; a relaxed mouth with a quick easy grin, ordinary teeth. Young, unlined skin.
palette: torch orange and ember red, olive green, faded blue, hemp rope beige, soot grey
casual: His driver's clothes: a faded blue cloth short-sleeved tunic, over it a sheepskin vest, three loops of hemp rope wound round the waist, the right hand wrapped in a strip of oil-soaked cloth up to the burn scar; brown trousers and thin worn leather boots; on his back the iron-hooped torch staff with its flame burning. He leans on one leg with a quick grin and the dimples showing.
private: Resting at a roadside fire: no staff, a loose undyed linen shirt with the collar open and the sleeves pushed up, the vest off, rolled trousers, thin old boots; the rope coiled and hung beside him. He feeds one stick to a small fire with his burned hand; a crooked friendly smile.
battle: Ready to light the way: the sheepskin vest buttoned, the hemp rope belted tight, leather gloves on both hands, boots laced. He grips the iron-hooped torch staff in his right hand held forward with the flame burning bright, a coil of rope over his left shoulder; braced and bright-eyed, the brows drawn together, the mouth set.
battle_pose: 3) the lamp-bearer outfit: braced and bright-eyed, the shoulders squared, the feet planted wide, the brows drawn together and the mouth set, gripping the burning torch staff forward in one hand and a coil of rope over the other shoulder; not smiling in this one.
formal: At the king's gate: a clean white linen shirt under a brushed brown wool vest laced shut with a leather thong, the hemp rope neatly coiled at the waist as a belt, the right hand bound in a fresh strip of oil-soaked cloth, boots wiped. The iron-hooped staff stands upright beside him with its flame burning small and steady, a gold that does not flicker. He stands with a calm, slightly shy half-smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the olive-green eyes looking straight at the viewer with a warm, bright, easy look and a small smile with the dimples showing. The torch flame burning beside his cheek lights the orange-red curls and the freckles from one side in warm orange, cold dusk blue on the other. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and a loop of hemp rope.

name: 希波拉
src: 月银纪史诗/第四歌_雷纹豹裘.md:316
who: Hipola, a human queen of the southern plain, a horse-lord queen of twenty-six: about 176 cm, long-legged and narrow-waisted with strong shoulders and back, a rider's body. Long black hair worked into dozens of thin braids, each braid tipped with a gold bead, that fan out behind her like a flag when she rides. Amber eyes with a faint red at the outer corners, a look that smiles and also cuts. Honey-brown skin from the steppe sun. A thin old scar on her collarbone (on the viewer's left when they face us). Bold, laughing, quick, generous. No glasses. Her hair is jet black, NOT brown and NOT chestnut, and her eyebrows are black too; the hair is worked into dozens of thin, narrow braids, far more than ten, each one ending in a single small gold bead.
face: FACE, as in the references: a grown woman's face of twenty-six: sharp amber almond eyes with a thin tapering dark upper lash line and a faint red at the outer corners; thin black eyebrows; a small straight nose; a mouth that smiles with the corner raised, ordinary teeth. Skin shadows a warm honey tone.
build: 176 cm, tall and long-legged: strong shoulders and back, a narrow waist, a full bust (an E-cup) and rounded hips; a rider's athletic body.
palette: ochre red and white fox, gold, steppe honey and black, grey horse
casual: Her queen's riding dress: a red-ochre felt robe that closes down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, the cuffs and hem trimmed with white fox fur, a belt of linked gold plaques each stamped with a running horse, leather riding boots; dozens of black braids with gold beads. A bright, bold look.
private: In her tent: a long-sleeved, high-necked soft undyed wool dress to the shins, a red felt sash, the braids loose over one shoulder, soft felt boots; she holds a bowl of mare's milk in both hands; a relaxed closed-mouth smile.
battle: Ready for a ride: the red-ochre felt robe belted tight under a coat of leather scale armour, fox-trimmed cuffs rolled back, riding boots, the gold plaque belt. She holds a horn bow in her left hand with an arrow nocked and a quiver of arrows at her hip; a fierce, laughing look, the braids flying.
battle_pose: 3) the riding outfit: braced and bold, the shoulders squared, the feet planted wide, the horn bow held out in the left hand with an arrow nocked, the right hand drawing the string back; a sharp, fierce look, the corner of the mouth raised.
formal: Receiving guests in the great tent: a full-length deep red felt robe embroidered with running horses at the hem, a white fox mantle, the gold plaque belt, every braid tipped with a fresh gold bead and a thin gold circlet. She stands straight with the hands folded; a proud, amused look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the amber eyes looking at the viewer with a bold, laughing, edged look, a half-smile. Warm low evening sun from one side, a cool dusk grey-blue on the other. Foreground blur: drifting grass seed and a flying gold bead on a braid. She wears the red-ochre robe with its white fox trim and the dozens of gold-beaded braids.

name: 奈菲
src: 月银纪史诗/第四歌_雷纹豹裘.md:372
who: Naifei, a human girl of fifteen, a shepherd girl of the hanging city: small, about 152 cm, a slight, light, petite frame, fully covered by her clothes. Cloud-white long hair, fluffy and light so that the wind lifts it, tied in two bunches with wool cords. Pale high-sky blue eyes, and she always looks up with her face tilted to the sky. Very fair, almost translucent skin. A pair of small bronze bells on her ears that ring when the wind comes. Barefoot, the soles soft and never walked on dirt. Curious, quiet, light as a bird.
palette: sky blue and cloud white, canvas cream, bronze, pebble grey
casual: A shin-length sky-blue wool dress-robe with long sleeves, a patched old canvas cape over her shoulders that fills with wind, a long wool rope round the waist ending in a small bronze hook, a string of rounded pebbles on her wrist, small bronze bells on her ears, bare feet. She looks up with an open, bright look, the mouth closed.
private: At home: a long-sleeved, high-necked soft white wool dress to the ankles with a pale blue sash, the cape off, the two bunches loosened, thin wool socks. She holds a lamb in her arms; a gentle closed-mouth smile.
battle: She does not fight: ready to climb, the sky-blue dress-robe belted tight with the wool rope, the canvas cape tied snug at her neck, leather gloves, soft leather climbing shoes laced to the ankle. She grips the rope in both hands with the bronze hook held forward; a focused, brave look, the mouth closed.
battle_pose: 3) the climbing outfit: braced and focused, the shoulders squared, the feet planted, both hands gripping the wool rope with the bronze hook held forward; a brave, set expression, the mouth closed.
formal: At the city's shrine day: a clean, freshly washed sky-blue wool dress-robe to the shins with long sleeves and a pale rope belt, the neck closed with a single carved bone pin, the washed canvas cape folded over one arm, small bronze bells at her ears, wisps of cloud-white mist seeming to cling to the hem. She stands with her hands folded in front; a quiet, shy look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the pale sky-blue eyes looking up and out with an open, bright, eager look, the mouth closed. Soft bright high-sky light from one side, a warm cream glow from the other. Foreground blur: floating tufts of wool and a drifting feather. She wears the canvas cape with the small bells at her ears.

name: 欧律
src: 月银纪史诗/第四歌_雷纹豹裘.md:568
who: Oryu, a human king of the city of Tirin in his fifties, the most timid king of the plain: about 168 cm, thin and slight, balding with a thin straggly goatee, small darting eyes. On his head a thin gold circlet set with a small blue water-core, the core his father killed, not him. Skin pale from living indoors. Fearful of everything, but sharp in his orders. No glasses. He is balding: the top and crown of his head are bare pale scalp, with only a little thin, short grey hair left above the ears and at the back of the head; no long hair, no fringe, no hair hanging over the forehead; the thin gold circlet sits on the bare scalp. This holds in every panel.
face: FACE, as in the references: a thin, nervous man's face of fifty-odd, NOT young: small pale grey darting eyes with lines at their corners, thin eyebrows, a long thin nose, a thin straggly goatee, a thin tight mouth; skin shadows a cool pale tone.
build: 168 cm, thin and slight, narrow shoulders.
palette: king's blue and pale gold, bronze, ivory, dusty grey
casual: His king's dress: a long heavy blue wool robe embroidered at the hem with a band of bronze thread, belted with a thin gold chain, dark trousers and soft pointed leather shoes; the gold circlet with the small blue core on his head. His hands are clasped tight together in front of his chest; a nervous look.
private: At night: a long undyed linen house tunic to the shins over trousers, a heavy grey wool shawl round the shoulders, soft slippers, the circlet off and held tight in both hands; a worried look.
battle: He does not fight: wrapped in a bronze-studded leather coat over the blue robe, a bronze helmet pulled down low, leather gloves, shoes buckled. He holds a plain staff of office in both hands out stiffly in front of him; a frightened but commanding look, the mouth set.
battle_pose: 3) the command outfit: stiff and wary, the shoulders drawn up, the feet together, both hands gripping a plain staff of office out in front; a frightened but commanding expression, the mouth set.
formal: On the throne day: a long deep blue velvet robe with a gold hem, a short ermine-trimmed cape, a heavy gold chain of office, the circlet set straight on the head. He stands stiffly with the hands folded; a stiff, anxious dignity.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the small pale grey eyes looking at the viewer with a quick, nervous, wary look, the mouth closed. Cold bronze-green light from one side, a dim warm lamp glow on the other. Foreground blur: the rim of a large bronze jar. He wears the blue robe and the circlet with its small blue core.

name: 皮罗
src: 月银纪史诗/第四歌_雷纹豹裘.md:606
who: Piro, a human boy of thirteen, a shepherd boy of the village under the rock: small, about 148 cm, a slight child, fully covered by his clothes. Messy straw-pale hair like a tuft of grass, big pale eyes that always look as if they are watching something far away. A thin, plain face with a quiet, grave look. A wooden shepherd's crook in one hand. Quiet, patient, stubborn, watching.
palette: straw pale and wool cream, hill green, brown wool, rope beige
casual: A shepherd boy's clothes: a plain long-sleeved undyed wool tunic to the knees over trousers, a sleeveless sheepskin vest, a rope belt, soft leather shoes bound with cord; a wooden crook in his right hand. A quiet, grave look, the mouth closed.
private: At home: a long-sleeved, high-necked soft wool shirt and trousers, thick wool socks, the vest off. He holds a lamb in his arms; a gentle closed-mouth smile.
battle: He does not fight: ready for a long watch on the hill, the sheepskin vest buttoned, a hooded wool cloak over the tunic, leather mittens, laced shoes. He holds the wooden crook upright in both hands; a steady, watchful look, the mouth closed.
battle_pose: 3) the watch outfit: still and steady, the shoulders squared, the feet planted, both hands gripping the wooden crook upright in front; a steady, watchful expression, the mouth closed.
formal: At the village's feast day: a clean long-sleeved undyed linen tunic to the knees under a brown wool vest closed with a single bone toggle, a rope belt, neat trousers, polished shoes, and a tiny stone charm on a cord that glows faintly in the dusk. He stands straight with the hands at his sides, holding the wooden crook, a shy, solemn look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the big pale eyes looking out at the viewer with a quiet, serious, steady look, the mouth closed. Soft golden hill light from one side, cool pale sky on the other. Foreground blur: blades of grass and a lamb's ear. He wears the sheepskin vest.

name: 提翁
src: 月银纪史诗/第四歌_雷纹豹裘.md:619
who: Tiweng, a human priest of the hanging city, a very old man who has served the shrine his whole life: about 170 cm, thin and slightly stooped. A long white beard to his waist, thin white hair, kind faded grey eyes. A deeply lined, gentle, stubborn face. He wears a woollen robe patched dozens of times, and in his right hand a staff cut from the top of a mast. Kind, fixed in his ways.
face: FACE, as in the references: a deeply lined old man's face of eighty, NOT young: kind faded grey eyes with deep creases, thin white eyebrows, a soft broad nose, a long white beard, a gentle closed mouth; skin shadows a warm pale tone.
palette: patched wool oatmeal and cream, white, mast-wood brown, pale grey
casual: His priest's robe: a long woollen robe patched dozens of times in many shades of undyed cream, oatmeal and grey, closing down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a rope belt, soft old leather shoes; the staff cut from a mast top in his right hand. A gentle, firm look.
private: At rest: a plain long undyed wool tunic with a thick grey shawl over the shoulders, soft slippers, the staff leaned in the crook of his arm. He holds a small cup in both hands; a mild, drowsy look.
battle: He does not fight: standing guard at the altar edge, the patched robe belted tight under a heavy wool mantle, fur-lined gloves, boots laced. He holds the mast staff upright in both hands; a firm, stubborn look, the mouth closed.
battle_pose: 3) the altar-guard outfit: upright and stubborn, the feet planted, both hands gripping the mast-top staff in front of the body; a firm, immovable expression, the mouth closed.
formal: At the city's great sacrifice: a clean long white wool robe with a blue border at the hem and cuffs, a pale grey mantle pinned with a plain bronze clasp, the beard combed. He stands upright with the staff held in front; a grave, solemn look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the kind faded grey eyes looking at the viewer with a gentle, firm, faithful look, the mouth closed. Soft bright high-sky light from one side, a warm lamp glow on the other. Foreground blur: drifting wisps of incense and cloud. He wears the patched robe.
